quotes.text: The core set contains 100 cases from MedThinkVQA, derived from peer-reviewed Eurorad teaching files

rationale: Three sources are named (MedThinkVQA/Eurorad, Indiana University Chest X-ray, MIMIC-CXR) with citations. No version, snapshot date, or route from a case to its source record is given.

quotes.text: MedImageEdu is built from public or de-identified radiology sources, including MedThinkVQA cases derived from peer-reviewed Eurorad teaching files

rationale: Origin is stated and case selection and construction are described (Section 3.1, Appendix A.1). No licence or terms, and no consent or IRB status or explicit 'not required', are stated.

quotes.text: We keep only cases where such questions can be answered from the provided report and images

rationale: A stated sampling and inclusion design (100/25/25 split across sources, inclusion criteria) and ICD-chapter case counts are given. There is no comparison against a named target population; the limitations say the 150 cases do not cover the full range.

quotes.text: Safety & Scope: report grounding, refusal of unsupported advice, and staying within educational scope.

rationale: Safety & Scope is a dedicated scored dimension for unsafe or out-of-scope output. No dedicated bias test is reported; the ethics statement says personalization results are stress tests, not evidence of fairness.
searched: S1 (paper, appendix, ethics, limitations), S2, S3, S4, S5. No gating, canary, held-out set, or overlap check is reported; S2-S5 have no chunks.

searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. The paper hides the patient profile from the DoctorAgent, but this is simulator state rather than ground-truth results, and no isolation of agent from gold or judge results is addressed. S2-S5 have no chunks.

searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. No data version, snapshot, or pinned judge, PatientAgent, or software is reported; the drawing tool (GPT Image 1.5) and the judge are external models without snapshot IDs. S2-S5 have no chunks.
searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. No oracle or reference solver or solvability check is reported.

searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. The task is a consultation with an optional drawing tool that returns images; no task changes persistent environment state. Base-image integrity is only a drawing-quality criterion, so the NA clause applies.

quotes.text: where visual support is substantively useful, and where the task cannot be solved by copying the report or by giving treatment advice

rationale: A design argument is given: cases are filtered so copying the report or giving treatment advice cannot solve the task. No empirical random or trivial-agent rate or chance rate is reported.
searched: S1 (Table 1, appendices), S2, S3, S4, S5. No do-nothing or random agent score is reported.

quotes.text: We validate the automatic evaluation with a 50-case human study.
Agreement between judge-induced preferences and expert preferences remains substantial

rationale: The benchmark validates its own LLM judge on its own outputs against two licensed radiologists, with agreement figures (judge vs expert kappa 0.584, 79.1% agreement, Spearman rho 0.587; inter-rater kappa 0.708).
searched: S1 (experimental design, appendix A.5, limitations), S2, S3, S4, S5. No seeds, temperature setting, or repeated-run policy is stated.

quotes.text: Model | Weighted mean | Chapter SD | Chapter range

rationale: Chapter-level SD and range are reported (Table 4, and Profile SD in Table 7). No CI or significance test is applied to the headline model comparison; the Spearman tests concern judge validation only.
searched: S1 (experimental design, A.5, limitations), S2, S3, S4, S5. No number of runs per task, seed or decoding policy, or run independence is stated.

searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. No CI or SE is reported on headline scores, no resampling unit is named, and clustering is not addressed; Appendix C notes the analyses are descriptive rather than inferential.
searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. No rerun, action-level agreement, state agreement, or pass^k metric is reported.

searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. Models are named by family and size only (e.g. GPT-5.1, Qwen3-VL-32B) with no snapshot ID or date. No decoding parameters, and no harness tag or commit; the judge and PatientAgent models are not identified.

quotes.text: The tool returns the resulting image(s), and the DoctorAgent then gives the patient a final multimodal answer

rationale: A benchmark-provided drawing tool is defined, so the item is not NA. Only the success return (image output) is described; no machine-readable schema, per-tool read/write side effects, or error returns are documented. S5 is absent (prompts omitted from the paper), so reach cannot be told.

searched: S1 (A.4, A.5), S2, S3, S4, S5. A drawing tool exists, so the item is not NA. No tool tests or conformance checks are reported, and the paper does not state whether any tool behaviour is simulated or stubbed. S5 is absent.

searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. The only action is the drawing-tool call, which returns images and mutates no environment state and is no clinical order, prescription, note, or message; the doctor's replies are the task output, not actions. The NA clause applies.

quotes.text: the Multi-turn Simulation block is scored from the consultation transcript

rationale: Grader input is named: an LLM judge scores the consultation transcript, and the drawing instructions, returned images and final response. The paper justifies it as a scalable proxy for expert assessment. The 50-case radiologist study reports pairwise agreement only, with no per-class error rates on labelled correct and incorrect outcomes.
searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. No controls on answer leakage through tools, retrieval, or web access, no held-out or private split, and no canary or provenance marker are reported.

quotes.text: We then re-slice the same outputs by cleaned ICD chapter and by patient profile attributes, including education level, health literacy, and interaction state.
ICD chapter | n | Consult. | Safety | Language | Overall

rationale: Results are sliced by ICD chapter, source dataset and simulated profile attributes, with n reported per ICD chapter and block. No results by real patient demographic subgroups (the profile attributes are simulated), and no statement that no demographic fields exist.

quotes.text: MedImageEdu is built from public or de-identified radiology sources, including MedThinkVQA cases derived from peer-reviewed Eurorad teaching files

rationale: Source is stated as real public or de-identified radiology data. No IRB determination, DUA or credentialing requirement, or de-identification method is stated, and no data terms are given separately from code licence.
